title: External-source direct-repair competitor benchmark
publicClaim: Named direct-repair products are compared only within the same frozen format cohort, using identical damaged inputs and healthy controls, complete terminal-outcome evidence, and independent PDF render/text or raster RGBA validation.
inclusionRules: Run every case in the selected frozen format cohort in manifest order.
Record every product-returned file in display order and preserve the exact product terminal outcome.
Require an eligible output-producing outcome and the independent validator before assigning verified-pass.
Treat an identical returned healthy control, or an explicit successful no-change result, as the desired behavior.
Disable AI enhancement, upscaling, recoloring, and assisted repair that uses a healthy sample.
exclusionRules: The source files are externally authored, but the structural mutations are benchmark-authored.
Do not compare products across formats or against cases outside their declared cohort.
Preview-only, watermarked, truncated, placeholder, unavailable, paywalled, or missing outputs do not pass.
Deleted-file and disk-recovery products require a separate storage-recovery protocol and are not scored here.
An unsigned attestation proves bundle integrity, not publisher identity.
